narrative: Enrollment of the pivotal trial's 900-patient biopsy population finished, with topline results guided for the third quarter of 2022. Nothing else in the primary program has changed since the trial launched.

checks.a1: Unresolved. Enrollment of the 900-patient biopsy population finished, with topline results guided for the third quarter of 2022. The Phase 2 signal has not yet been tested at Phase 3 scale.
checks.a2: Supported. The pivotal Phase 3 trial launched in the primary indication, and a second Phase 3 study opened enrollment in a related population. This does not establish what the regulator required or whether either trial will succeed.
checks.a3: Unresolved. The company's cash position is not matched here against a disclosed Phase 3 budget. This record cannot establish whether it will last to the readout without a raise.
checks.a4: Unresolved. Whether five years is too long for the price to reward success depends on when results and any approval land. This starting record cannot settle either the timing or the reward.
checks.a5: Unresolved. The starting record leaves the clinical and regulatory questions open. It does not establish a position either way.

assumptions.text: The Phase 2 biopsy results will replicate in a large Phase 3.
The regulator will agree a trial design that this drug can pass.
Cash is enough to reach the readout without a dilutive raise.
Even if the drug works, five years is too long for the price to reward it.
I don't have enough evidence to take a position either way.
